meta.title: Midnight Watch — Tulsa Release Tracker
meta.data_status: MIXED — each record carries a `verification` field. `live` = checked against the US storefront on generated_at (all 357 Impulse rows). `publisher` = from Marvel/DC/press pages, not a retailer. `directory` = store facts confirmed via Google Places on Sep 9; inventory not surveyed. No demo rows remain.

verification_levels.demo: Demo / verification required — no live source

meta.image_policy: Midnight Spider-Man cover images are the retailer's own product photos, saved into covers/ by fetch_covers.py (22 of 26 — Impulse has not uploaded art for #2 Covers B, D, E, F yet). Absolute Batman rows link to the retailer image and are not stored.

signals.title: Live preorder
signals.text: Midnight Spider-Man #2 Covers A–F are on preorder at Impulse at $3.74 (25% off cover). FOC Oct 9. This is the only Tulsa-area buy path the monitor can see.
signals.label: #2 Cover A

signals.title: #1 is gone online
signals.text: All 20 Midnight Spider-Man #1 SKUs at Impulse (A–J plus signed) show a disabled Sold-out button. Ask in store about unlisted or late-allocation copies before Oct 7.
signals.label: Cover A page

signals.title: Call-first stores
signals.text: Route 66 blocks automated reads and most metro shops publish no per-title inventory. Their pages are listed, but phone confirmation remains fastest — numbers are in the table.
signals.label: Route 66 / Sparky's

issues.note: Solicited Oct 21; Impulse's listing tag says Oct 28. Greg Capullo variant (Cover C) confirmed.
